notes: FY2021 10-K filed 2022-02-09. Cohort focus: J-Book exposure divergence pattern. Hexcel is a Tier-2 composites supplier (carbon fiber, prepregs, honeycomb); it does NOT prime DoD programs and therefore does not name Program Elements. Most defense exposure is articulated as platform-level (F-35, V-22, UH-60, CH-53K, A400M) and customer-level (Lockheed Martin, Boeing, Sikorsky, Bell). J-Book look-ups will be done by platform-as-program-name and by contractor where defensible, but most claims are expected to flag NOT_FOUND/UNVERIFIABLE because Hexcel sells at the materials layer, not the Program-of-Record layer.

claims.claim_text: The F-35 program is Hexcel's largest Space & Defense program and represents less than 25% of revenues in the Space & Defense market.
claims.subject: F-35 Lightning II program
claims.object_value: <25% of S&D segment revenue (S&D was 33% of 2021 total sales)
claims.source_quote: We are qualified to supply materials to a broad range of military aircraft, commercial helicopter and space programs, including the Lockheed Martin F-35 (Lightning), Bell-Boeing V-22 (Osprey) tilt rotor aircraft, UH-60 Black Hawk and Airbus A400M military transport. The F-35, which is our largest program, represents less than 25% of revenues in this [S&D] market.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel supplies the Bell-Boeing V-22 Osprey tilt-rotor program; V-22 blades were one of the two largest blade programs in 2021.
claims.subject: Bell-Boeing V-22 Osprey
claims.object_value: one of two largest blade programs in 2021
claims.source_quote: The UH-60 wide chord blade program and blades for the V-22 were the two largest blade programs in 2021.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel supplies the UH-60 Black Hawk; the UH-60 wide-chord blade program is one of Hexcel's two largest blade programs.
claims.subject: UH-60 Black Hawk wide-chord blade program
claims.object_value: one of two largest blade programs in 2021
claims.source_quote: The UH-60 wide chord blade program and blades for the V-22 were the two largest blade programs in 2021.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel calls the CH-53K heavy-lift transport helicopter a future growth program, including composite helicopter blades.
claims.subject: CH-53K King Stallion
claims.source_quote: CH-53K is a future growth program, including the composite helicopter blades and new helicopter programs in development which use Hexcel composites in prototypes.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel is qualified to supply the Airbus A400M military transport.
claims.subject: Airbus A400M Atlas
claims.source_quote: We are qualified to supply materials to a broad range of military aircraft, commercial helicopter and space programs, including ... and Airbus A400M military transport.

claims.claim_text: Space sales (launchers and satellites) declined in 2021 but space applications including solid rocket booster cases, fairings, payload doors and satellite buses/solar arrays are a continuing demand source. Sales depend upon program funding levels.
claims.subject: Government-funded space launch and satellite programs
claims.object_value: Space sub-market down 3.0% in 2021 to $434.9M; explicitly funding-dependent
claims.source_quote: Space applications for advanced composites include solid rocket booster cases, fairings and payload doors for both government funded and commercial launch vehicles, and satellite buss and solar arrays for military and commercial satellites... The sales from these programs are dependent upon those that are funded and the extent of the funding.

claims.claim_text: No single Space & Defense program other than the F-35 accounts for more than 10% of revenues in that market; the rest of S&D is diversified across many named military aircraft, rotorcraft and space programs.
claims.subject: Hexcel Space & Defense segment diversification
claims.source_quote: The F-35, which is our largest program, represents less than 25% of revenues in this market. No other program accounts for more than 10% of our revenues in this market. The sales from these programs are dependent upon those that are funded and the extent of the funding.

claims.claim_text: Two customers and their related subcontractors accounted for approximately 49% of Hexcel's annual net sales in 2021 (down from 52% in 2020 and 64% in 2019). Airbus and its subcontractors were 33% of 2021 net sales (29% Commercial Aerospace + 4% S&D); Boeing and its subcontractors were 16% (12% CA + 4% S&D).
claims.subject: Top-2 customer concentration (Airbus and Boeing)
claims.object_value: 49% of 2021 net sales from top-2; Airbus 33%, Boeing 16%
claims.source_quote: Two customers and their related subcontractors accounted for approximately 49% of our annual net sales in 2021, 52% in 2020 and 64% in 2019.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel operates manufacturing facilities in the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe, India and Africa, serving commercial aerospace, space and defense, and industrial markets.
claims.subject: Global manufacturing footprint
claims.source_quote: We serve international markets through manufacturing facilities, sales offices and representatives located in the Americas, Asia Pacific, Europe, India, and Africa.

claims.claim_text: Hexcel increased its PAN and carbon fiber capacity in recent years to serve aerospace demand; a new production line can take up to a year to qualify after start-up.
claims.subject: Carbon fiber / PAN capacity expansion
claims.source_quote: With the increasing demand for carbon fiber, particularly in aerospace applications, in recent years we increased our PAN and carbon fiber capacity to serve the growing needs of our customers and our own downstream products.
